page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-48-lssd is a virtual machine instance configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. The system features 186 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. This instance includes 1611 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across four physical drives, providing high-speed local read and write capabilities directly attached to the hypervisor.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from neighboring tenants. The inclusion of local NVMe SSD storage eliminates network latency for disk operations, making this instance profile highly efficient for workloads requiring rapid temporary storage access. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the bundled local storage and balanced memory-to-core ratio offer a dense resource footprint that reduces the need for external block storage attachments.

This server configuration is designed for workloads that require a balance of compute power, memory, and fast local storage. Suitable applications include relational databases, transactional systems, data caching layers, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from high-speed scratch space or local indexing.
